items.title: Maude Johnson Interview, 1959-01-06
items.q: Well, I was- we were in Lake Charles at that time... And when Bunk first came to Tony's Bob-Amband in Lake Charles, Louisiana, well, that's where I met him that night.

ctx.x: Um, but he- He's one they call Candy, isn't it? Yeah. Yeah. Is he able to talk? I wondered maybe if we could interview him someday. Yeah, he could talk. Because he knew quite a bit about Bunk, too.
Yeah, because through him, that's the way I met Bunk. Oh, is that right?
Yeah. That's what I'd like to know, if you can tell about that while we're talking.
